summary: The filing reports a routine issuance of 637 shares of Class I common stock for $0.01M, a dividend declaration of $0.14/share, and a net asset value disclosure. The share issuance is a standard monthly subscription under an exempt continuous offering. There is no M&A, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change event. The dividend and NAV update are ordinary course for a BDC. No special situation exists.
